source.check: deemed re-elected (no nomination; the sitting members were returned: Frontier Sentinel, 1939-05-06, p. 5); sat as a member in the council-meeting report of the Banbridge Chronicle, 1939-06-10, p. 6 (annual meeting of the new council, Monday 5 June 1939) (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. Only six nominations were received for the 20 seats, so there was no contest; the remaining members were automatically returned. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The members deemed re-elected in the divisions with no nomination are recorded from reports of the council's meetings early in the term (Banbridge Chronicle), each with its division from the previous return or from the co-option report naming the predecessor (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Division inferred from the 4 June 1936 return (Samuel Chambers, Scarva); the Banbridge Chronicle, 10 June 1939, p. 6 names the member as sitting on the council early in the term. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
